prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph shot on cheap colour film, visible grain, slight halation. A lone adult in a worn parka, seen from behind, stands at a padlocked chain-link gate to a British council allotment site at the edge of a housing estate. In one hand, lowered at their side and readable to us, a folded council letter whose top line reads "You are on our waiting list". A heavy padlock and rusted chain loop the gate. Beyond it, dark shapes of sheds and bean poles. One fluorescent security lamp on a pole casts a cold teal light over the wet path; the sky is deep blue-black. Quiet, lonely, faintly eerie. No other people. Thanks.
